DAREDEVIL: DAMNED Unleashes Justice In Aleks Le’s Brutal New Fan Film

Discover more
MOVIE
Stream Indie Films
Movies
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

Lee B. Golden III Shortfilms, Watch Now aleks le, daredevil damned, filmcombatsyndicate.com 0

“Marvel’s Daredevil” may have run its course on the live-action TV end of things, but that won’t stop the fandom creatives from living up to the hype. Enter TV and video game voice actor Aleks Le (“Solo Leveling,” “Star Wars Visions”) to present his own inspired treatment of the IP with a non-commercial fan short chronicling the character’s nightly endeavors in Daredevil: Dammed.

Le previously voiced the character for the 2024 “Marvel Rivals” game. Combined with his vested interest in the character and experience, and the team involved including action coordinators Noah Fleder and Christopher Troy, and ten months of Le’s hard-earned effort sans any generative AI slop as common as that’s become lately, and you have a genuinely-crafted project that rightly earns your attention and support.

Check it out below and share, and give this guy a follow on the socials if you’re up to it!

NEVER SURRENDER: Don’t Miss The Latest Teaser Trailer, Promos And Poster For Sidharta Tata’s New Indonesian Action Thriller

Lee B. Golden III Posters, Stream This, Teasers, Trailers derby romero, donny alamsyah, filmcombatsyndicate.com, lukman sardi, netflix, never surrender, sidharta tata 0

The big mystery remains as to when the rest of us poor souls outside of Asia will ever get to check out Sidharta Tata’s action flick, Ikatan Darah, here in the states. In the meantime, the director’s latest now has a stake in Netflix with upcoming action thriller, Never Surrender, which bows on the streamer on November 12.

We already got a glimpse of what this action flick will entail back in February, marking Tata’s first collaboration with producers Kimo Stamboel and Edwin Nazir (DreadOut). At long last though, the streamer is finally picking up with a valid new teaser poster, as well as some enticing teaser trailer character promos.

Set in a small village in Central Java, a grandfather accustomed to living alone must care for his two grandchildren, whom he has not seen in a long time. However, a major problem from Jakarta follows them — and a group of ruthless criminals storms their home, trapping them in a life-threatening situation. To survive, the grandfather and his grandchildren have only two choices: surrender or fight back.

Also, feel free to mind the newest unit still included the gallery below and how awesomely it coincides with the new key art as a keen visual aide. Sweet stuff.

Never Surrender stars Lukman Sardi, Callista Arum, Sulthan Hamonangan, Derby Romero and Donny Alamsyah, from a script by Tata and co-writer Khalid Kashogi.
